title: Experimental Flags
description: Validates experimental flags in world templates. Experiments that were enabled can affect world behavior even after being disabled.

101.title: Experiment Active
101.description: Warning when an experimental flag is or was enabled in the world. Some experiments permanently modify world data even after being turned off.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the name of the experimental flag

102.title: Missing Level.dat
102.description: Error when the world's level.dat file could not be found. The world may be corrupted or incomplete.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the expected level.dat path

103.title: World Not Found
103.description: Error when the world folder could not be located. Check that the world path is correct and accessible.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the expected world path
